meta.name: video-editor
meta.description: Cinematic video post-production for TeamDay. Extract reference frames, compose multi-scene sequences with per-scene colour grading + text overlays + xfade transitions, append TeamDay logo endcards, mux music. Pattern ported from Jam/SuperScale's Seedance 2.0 pipeline. Use after Seedance/Kling/Wan generation to assemble a final branded film.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑调色多段素材,合成带品牌片尾的成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做完AI视频生成后想把素材拼成完整成片。
copy.tagline_en: Assemble multi-scene clips into a branded film with grading and transitions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to assemble AI-generated clips into a final branded film.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 AI 生成视频片段后做后期:抽帧分析参考片、多场景合成(逐场景调色+文字叠加+转场)、追加 TeamDay 片尾、混入音乐,输出成品牌化电影成片。
howto.when: 当 Seedance/Kling/Wan 等已生成视频片段、用户要求组装成带品牌片尾的成片,或要求“照这个视频的风格重做”时触发。

say.text: 把这几个片段合成一支带转场的成片,稍加调色
say.note: 触发多场景合成,逐段调色加转场

say.text: 照这个参考视频的风格,重新做一支片子
say.note: 抽帧分析参考片的调色与构图

say.text: 给成片加上 TeamDay 片尾和背景音乐
say.note: 调用脚本追加片尾并混入音乐

howto.what_en: Assembles AI-generated clips into a branded film: extracts reference frames for style analysis, composes multi-scene sequences with colour grading, text overlays and xfade transitions, appends a TeamDay endcard, and muxes audio.
howto.when_en: Triggers after footage is generated by Seedance/Kling/Wan and the user wants a finished branded film, or when asked to recreate an existing video's style (e.g. 'recreate this video in our style').

say_en.text: Cut these clips into a finished film with crossfades and light grading.
say_en.note: Runs compose_scenes.py to assemble and grade the scenes.

say_en.text: Recreate this reference video in our style.
say_en.note: Extracts frames from the reference for vision analysis.

say_en.text: Add the TeamDay endcard and background music to the final cut.
say_en.note: Appends the endcard and muxes audio without re-encoding.
